tasks.reason: Original compile failure reproduced in 001. The model received R-CDC/T-001/T-002 before 002 but only removed duplicate declarations. Final binary pointers remain two bits and Gray conversion is not full binary XOR shifted. Frozen bank 003 passes, while model diagnostics 005/007 watchdog-fail; 008-010 are identical TB writes and the host stops before another API call. An independent same-source capacity test now observes the third write blocked with no reads, before the specified four slots are filled. The model TB also serially attempts more than capacity without a reader, so its watchdog alone is not isolated DUT evidence. No corrected CDC implementation or physical CDC sign-off exists.

Original simulation failed in 001. R-ROUND was sent in API 003 before DUT write 002. The model implemented signed floor quotient, nonnegative remainder, a zero-or-positive-one increment, and saturation after rounding. Its first TB failed to compile because expect is a SystemVerilog keyword; write 005 renamed the unused variable, diagnostic 006 and frozen bank 007 passed. The model diagnostic checks 23 directed inputs. Independent developer simulation enumerated all 65,536 signed 16-bit inputs using magnitude-based rounding and passed on the same final DUT. This exhaustive simulation is not formal proof. The accepted model diagnosis falsely says the original saturated after truncation and all half values rounded away from zero: original code contains no saturation; the direct positive bias does not implement that signed tie behavior. Preserve and reject those narrative claims, not the verified repair.

The original failed in 001. Delivered R-FORK aligns with actual DUT write 002: per-branch pending state, independent retirement, no replacement on completion edge. Model diagnostic 004/006 fails with last data wrong. The TB drives and checks in the active region and leaves s_valid high across additional acceptance opportunities while treating a named item as a single transaction. Rewriting monitor assignments to NBA does not repair the driver sequence or post-NBA checks. Three identical writes stop the agent; no model final bank or summary exists. Separate developer-corrected protocol TB and real frozen compilation/elaboration/simulation/synthesis both pass on the exact final model DUT. These are developer verification, not model-requested corrections or autonomous completion.

Original failure 001 and actual DUT edit 002 are this run's evidence; R-STALL was delivered before the edit. Model diagnostic 004 and frozen bank 005 pass. The new TB releases reset on a falling edge but holds A valid through extra stalled cycles after acceptance, thereby offering another A, then changes that pending offer to B. Static review identifies a violation of the public input-stability contract. The model also lets identical values transfer multiple times without accepted-event counting. Its first summary 006 is rejected for incorrect rule fields; 007 is accepted, but None known does not resolve the TB flaw. A separate corrected developer TB enforces source stability, captures pre-edge events, checks post-NBA state, counts transfers and passes on this run's final DUT. The corrected fixture already rejected the original faulty DUT in preflight. Do not replace the model's original test or count developer correction as autonomous success.

Starts from an empty DUT, not an original buggy starter. R-FIFO/R-PARAM were delivered before actual DUT write 003; count-based full replacement and explicit parameter wrap align with those rules. Model TB write 004 checks ready after the third item fills depth three but still expects ready high; diagnostic 005 correctly fails. Write proposal 006 is byte-identical to the current TB and rejected during the reserved closing phase, not an executed correction. Frozen evaluation 007 passes DEPTH 3,1,9 on this run's final source. Before API 008, conservative per-task token reservation stops dispatch; seven actual responses total 39,052 tokens, not eight requests or global budget exhaustion. The H09/R-CONTRACT context prepared after the final bank was never sent in a new API request. A separate developer TB checks pre-edge acceptance, post-NBA occupancy/head, stable blocked offers, full replacement, wrap, drain and reset; real simulation passes on the same DUT. Final verification is now available with clear mixed authorship, but there is no completed API correction loop or accepted summary.
